data.narrative:
Aalyria, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Chris Taylor, has raised $130M+ and holds a current post-money valuation of $1.3B. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public-market peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies in the same sector and stage band, including Cowboy Space Corporation, Sierra Space, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage transitions, yielding $2.5B. Peer-median benchmarking across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces $2.0B; the peer range spans $1.1B to $8.0B, reflecting material dispersion within space infrastructure valuations. Public-comp anchoring via sector P/S multiples (25.3x median across 6 tickers) could not be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, standard for private companies.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a median valuation of $2.2B, with a low estimate of $1.7B and high of $2.8B. This range sits modestly above the current $1.3B valuation, consistent with expected step-up in a Series B-to-C progression. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and the wide dispersion observed in peer valuations—a 7x spread suggests stage and market positioning meaningfully affect pricing within the space sector.
